name: Irijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: At the gate of Benjamin a captain of the ward named Irijah seizes him, charging that he is falling away to the Chaldeans; Jeremiah answers that it is false, but Irijah will not hear him.

note.label: Jeremiah 37: The Prophet Arrested and Imprisoned
